Yes — Americans can visit Phu Quoc Island visa-free, no visa needed. Details:

- Duration: up to 30 days
- Conditions: you must arrive directly from outside Vietnam by air or sea (not via mainland Vietnam), and your passport must be valid for at least 180 days from your entry date
- Restriction: this exemption only covers Phu Quoc Island itself — if you travel to mainland Vietnam, the exemption is voided and you'll need a separate visa

If you do plan to visit the mainland too, Americans are eligible for Vietnam's e-Visa (available to all nationalities), good for up to 90 days, costing USD 25 (single entry) or USD 50 (multiple entry), processed in about 2-3 business days via evisa.gov.vn.

This is based on policy data as of 2026-08-17 — I'd recommend double-checking current rules at https://evisa.gov.vn/ before you travel.
